_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'saltmouth' (Saltmouth). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

harbourmaster_orla.name: Harbourmaster Orla Pike
harbourmaster_orla.greeting: Ships in, ships out, smugglers in between.

net_mender.name: Old Netty
net_mender.greeting: Nets mended. Gulls insulted. Both for free.

gunner_wat.name: Gunner Wat
gunner_wat.greeting: The battery's guns face the sea. The trouble keeps coming from land.

smuggler_jory.name: Jory Coombe
smuggler_jory.greeting: I'm a respectable importer. Of things. Don't look in the barrel.

quests.name: Crabs and Cutthroats
quests.offer: Smugglers are landing cargo on the beach at night, and the centipedes are landing on the smugglers. It's chaos. Tidy it.

quests.name: Gull Steps
quests.offer: Serpents in the rock pools bite the children. The children bite back, but they're losing.
quests.done: The children win. Hurrah for the children.

quests.name: A Respectable Importer
quests.offer: My competitors are shooting at my boats. Persuade their archers to stop. Permanently-ish.
quests.done: Business is good again. You saw nothing. Here's nothing, in coin.

quests.name: Moths in the Powder
quests.offer: Carrion moths got into the powder store. Don't ask what they were eating. Kill them before someone lights a pipe.
quests.done: Nobody blew up. That's a good day at the battery.

quests.name: The Flooded Vaults
quests.offer: The old harbour vaults flooded when the sea wall cracked. Something big moved in with the tide.
quests.done: The tide's back where it belongs: outside.

quests.name: Something in the Surf
quests.offer: There's a thing in the surf the fishermen won't name. I'll name it: target.
quests.done: Target hit. That's why they pay me.
